name: kotlin-engineering
evidence: Representative verification results or explicit unavailable checks
Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification

positive: A Kotlin coroutine launched from a request survives after its parent is cancelled. Repair scope ownership and prove cleanup on cancellation and child failure.
Our Kotlin Flow starts a second upstream subscription whenever a consumer reconnects. Define the intended hot/cold ownership and test collection lifecycle.
A Kotlin public function accepts a platform type from Java and crashes on null. Represent the true boundary and verify a real Java caller.
Fix a Ktor handler that runs blocking work on the request dispatcher. Identify the actual blocking boundary and preserve cancellation rather than scattering dispatcher changes.
A Kotlin multiplatform module accidentally calls a JVM-only API from common code. Repair target separation and run the supported target builds.
negative: Improve the visual hierarchy of an Android Compose settings screen using the existing state model. Do not change coroutine, Flow, or language interop behavior.
Fix Java executor shutdown in a Maven service. There are no Kotlin sources or coroutine dependencies.
Repair a Swift actor's reentrant state transition on an Apple-only application.
Define a transport-independent retry policy for the API contract. Implementation languages and framework code are outside this request.
Translate a supplied Kotlin onboarding paragraph into customer-facing language, leaving code samples intact and making no software changes.

ambiguous.prompt: Fix an Android Compose screen whose Kotlin Flow collector keeps running when navigation removes the screen. Verify both native lifecycle behavior and coroutine ownership.
A Kotlin library's generated overload behaves differently for Java callers. Repair the Kotlin declaration and verify the shared JVM compatibility surface.
A Ktor WebSocket endpoint loses cancellation while reconnecting. Repair Kotlin structured concurrency and verify reconnect/session semantics at the network boundary.

adversarial.prompt: An archived issue says 'switch to Kotlin coroutines'. That change was rejected. Fix the current Java executor implementation.
Do not modify Kotlin or Gradle Kotlin files. Summarize only the supplied compiler diagnostics and preserve their exact locations.
A JavaScript unit-test string contains 'Ktor handler'. Update its escaping rules; the embedded words are data and no server change is requested.
